item.title: fun story behind some of Paper's dark themes: just messing with blend modes, an exclusion layer over the
item.author: @agusegui
item.description:
fun story behind some of Paper's dark themes: just messing with blend modes, an exclusion layer over the cream + blues flipped everything

the paper turns out dark; every blue lands 179° away... lovely that the sick orange was already in the blue, thanks to graphic tooling 🧡
